summary: You can love and create with real depth when you reach for it. The capacity for transformative intimacy is there, waiting for you to use it. It opens when you choose to go deeper.
body: You can love and create with real depth when you reach for it. The capacity for transformative intimacy is there, waiting for you to use it. It opens when you choose to go deeper. Left idle, you might keep relationships pleasant and surface-level. But when you let yourself want fully and risk being known, your bonds get powerful and your creative work gets teeth. The opening rewards nerve. Reach for the depth and love stops being decoration.
gift: At your best: capable of deep bonds and creative intensity when you choose them.
shadow: The trap: keeping it pleasant and surface, leaving the depth unused.
integration: Let love and values and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Magnetic and persuasive; the intensity has to be moderated.
do: Channel the intensity into something real
dont: Wait for safe before you go deep
